meta.name: MedCopilot Design System
meta.description: Extracted design tokens and component specs from Timeline, GetAllEssays, UrgencyDashboard, SmartCalendarView, ViewAllActivities, RecentActivity, QuickInsights, AnalyticsView to recreate the UI with Tailwind CSS.

nav.container: flex gap-2 p-1.5 bg-white rounded-lg border border-border.light shadow-subtle w-fit

button.base: flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-3 rounded-md font-medium text-text.secondary transition duration-swift ease-swift

heroCard.wrapper: rounded-2xl border border-border.light shadow-command overflow-hidden backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/95

metric.base: flex items-center gap-3.5 p-6 bg-white transition duration-swift ease-swift
metric.clickable: cursor-pointer transition-all duration-300 ease-swift hover:-translate-y-[2px] hover:shadow-[0_8px_25px_rgba(0,0,0,0.15)] hover:border hover:border-[rgba(59,130,246,0.3)]
metric.label: text-[0.8125rem] font-medium text-text.secondary uppercase tracking-wide-1

statusBadge.base: flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-3 rounded-lg font-semibold text-[0.9375rem] tracking-tight-1 transition duration-swift ease-swift shadow-subtle

header.title: text-[2rem] font-bold text-[#1f2937] tracking-tight-2
header.banner: inline-flex items-center px-4 py-2 bg-[#ecfdf5] border border-[#d1fae5] rounded-full text-[0.875rem] font-semibold text-[#059669]

filters.panel: flex flex-col gap-8 mb-8 p-6 bg-white rounded-2xl border border-[#e5e7eb] shadow-[0_1px_3px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)]

search.input: w-full px-12 py-3.5 border-[1.5px] border-[#e5e7eb] rounded-xl text-[0.9375rem] bg-white transition focus:outline-none focus:border-[#2563eb] focus:shadow-[0_0_0_3px_rgba(37,99,235,0.1)] placeholder:text-[#9ca3af]

filters.toggleModern: flex items-center gap-2.5 px-5 py-3.5 bg-white border-[1.5px] border-[#e2e8f0] rounded-[12px] text-[0.9375rem] font-semibold text-[#475569] shadow-[0_1px_3px_rgba(0,0,0,0.05)] transition hover:bg-[#f8fafc] hover:border-[#cbd5e1] hover:-translate-y-[1px] hover:shadow-[0_4px_12px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)] data-[active=true]:bg-[#2563eb] data-[active=true]:border-[#2563eb] data-[active=true]:text-white

pills.group: flex items-center gap-2 bg-[#f8fafc] border-[1.5px] border-[#e2e8f0] rounded-[12px] px-3.5 py-2.5 min-w-[160px] flex-1 max-w-[200px]

filters.clearButton: flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3.5 py-2 bg-[#fef2f2] border-[1.5px] border-[#fecaca] rounded-[12px] text-[0.8125rem] font-semibold text-[#dc2626] uppercase tracking-[0.025em]

modal.overlay: fixed inset-0 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center z-[100]
modal.card: bg-white rounded-2xl p-8 max-w-[500px] w-[90%] shadow-[0_25px_50px_rgba(0,0,0,0.25)]

toast.card: fixed bottom-8 right-8 flex items-center gap-3 px-5 py-4 bg-white border border-[#e5e7eb] rounded-xl shadow-[0_10px_25px_rgba(0,0,0,0.1)] max-w-[400px] z-[100]

urgencyDashboard.card: bg-white rounded-lg border border-border.light shadow-subtle overflow-hidden
urgencyDashboard.header: flex items-center justify-between px-6 py-5 border-b border-border.light bg-[linear-gradient(135deg,#fafbfc_0%,#f8fafc_100%)]

task.wrapper: rounded-lg border border-border.light bg-white overflow-hidden transition hover:-translate-y-[1px] hover:shadow-soft

urgencyDashboard.actionBtn: flex items-center justify-center gap-2 px-4 py-3 rounded-md text-white text-[0.875rem] font-medium bg-command.primary transition hover:bg-[#3a56d4] hover:-translate-y-[1px] shadow-soft

calendar.container: bg-white rounded-[16px] border border-[#e5e7eb] shadow-[0_4px_16px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)] overflow-hidden
calendar.header: px-7 py-6 border-b border-[#f3f4f6] bg-[linear-gradient(135deg,#fafbfc_0%,#f8fafc_100%)] flex items-start justify-between
calendar.nav: flex items-center justify-between px-7 py-5 border-b border-[#f3f4f6]
calendar.days: grid grid-cols-7 gap-px bg-[#f3f4f6] rounded-[12px] p-[1px]

day.base: min-h-[60px] bg-white flex flex-col items-center justify-start relative px-1.5 py-2 rounded-[8px] transition hover:bg-[#f8fafc] hover:-translate-y-[1px]

calendar.sidebar: bg-[#fafbfc] border-l border-[#e5e7eb] p-6 max-h-[600px] overflow-y-auto

recentActivity.card: bg-white rounded-lg border border-border.light shadow-subtle overflow-hidden
recentActivity.header: flex items-center justify-between px-6 py-5 border-b border-border.light bg-[linear-gradient(135deg,#fafbfc_0%,#f8fafc_100%)]

item.marker: w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-white border-2 border-border.light grid place-items-center

recentActivity.actionBtn: px-3.5 py-2 border border-border.default rounded-md text-text.secondary text-[0.8125rem] font-medium transition hover:bg-[rgba(67,97,238,0.1)] hover:border-border.accent hover:text-command.primary hover:-translate-y-[1px]

header.wrapper: sticky top-0 z-[100] bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-2xl border-b border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.6)] px-10 py-8 pb-6
header.title: text-[2.5rem] font-bold bg-clip-text text-transparent bg-[linear-gradient(135deg,#1e293b_0%,#475569_100%)]

viewAllActivities.search: flex items-center bg-[rgba(248,250,252,0.8)] border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.5)] rounded-[14px] px-4 min-w-[300px] focus-within:bg-white focus-within:border-[rgba(99,102,241,0.4)] focus-within:shadow-[0_0_0_3px_rgba(99,102,241,0.1)]
viewAllActivities.filterToggle: flex items-center gap-2 bg-[rgba(248,250,252,0.8)] border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.5)] rounded-[14px] px-5 py-3 font-medium text-[#475569] transition hover:bg-white hover:border-[rgba(99,102,241,0.4)]

section.wrapper: mb-6 bg-white/70 border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.4)] rounded-[20px] overflow-hidden transition hover:bg-white/85 hover:border-[rgba(203,213,225,0.6)] hover:-translate-y-[1px] hover:shadow-[0_8px_25px_rgba(0,0,0,0.06)]
section.header: relative px-8 py-5 grid place-items-center bg-[linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(248,250,252,0.8)_0%,rgba(241,245,249,0.8)_100%)] border-b border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.3)]
section.count: bg-[linear-gradient(135deg,#6366f1_0%,#8b5cf6_100%)] text-white text-[0.75rem] font-semibold px-1.5 py-1 rounded-[12px] shadow-[0_2px_8px_rgba(99,102,241,0.2)]

card.base: bg-white/80 border border-[rgba(226,232,240,0.5)] rounded-[16px] p-5 transition hover:bg-white/95 hover:border-[rgba(203,213,225,0.8)] hover:-translate-y-[2px] hover:shadow-[0_8px_25px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)]

quickInsights.card: rounded-[20px] p-6 border border-[rgba(99,102,241,0.2)] shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(99,102,241,0.15),_0_4px_16px_rgba(0,0,0,0.1),_inset_0_1px_0_rgba(255,255,255,0.1)] relative overflow-hidden bg-[linear-gradient(135deg,#1a1d3a_0%,#2d1b69_100%)]
quickInsights.title: text-[#e5e7eb] text-[18px] font-semibold
quickInsights.chip: bg-[linear-gradient(135deg,#fbbf24,#f59e0b)] text-[#1f2937] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-[10px] text-[12px] font-semibold shadow-[0_2px_4px_rgba(251,191,36,0.3)]

insight.base: bg-white/5 border border-white/10 rounded-[16px] p-5 transition hover:-translate-y-[2px] hover:shadow-[0_8px_25px_rgba(0,0,0,0.15)]

analytics.periodBtn: px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md text-[#64748b] font-medium bg-[#f3f4f6] hover:bg-white hover:text-[#1f2937] hover:shadow-sm

button.base: inline-flex items-center gap-2 font-medium transition duration-swift ease-swift rounded-md

variants.secondary: bg-command.accentLight border border-command.accent text-command.accent hover:bg-command.accent hover:text-white
variants.ghost: bg-transparent border border-border.default text-text.secondary hover:bg-command.primaryLight hover:text-command.primary

badge.count: inline-flex items-center justify-center min-w-[20px] h-[20px] rounded-full text-white text-[0.75rem] font-bold bg-[#ef4444]

card.glass: bg-white/95 border border-border.light rounded-2xl shadow-command backdrop-blur-xl

form.input: w-full px-12 py-3.5 border-[1.5px] border-[#e5e7eb] rounded-xl text-[0.9375rem] bg-white transition focus:outline-none focus:border-[#2563eb] focus:shadow-[0_0_0_3px_rgba(37,99,235,0.1)] placeholder:text-[#9ca3af]
form.selectPill: appearance-none bg-transparent border-0 outline-0 text-[0.875rem] font-medium text-[#1e293b] cursor-pointer absolute inset-0 opacity-0
